en: The postcard features a black-and-white printed image of a well-furnished interior room, possibly a guest room or a bedroom. The room contains a double bed, single bed, a table with chairs, and patterned textiles covering the furniture. There is a wall hanging with decorative text above the bed. The right side of the postcard contains printed German text, and handwritten notes are present along the top and left margins.
